newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela bolivar ends firm on weak dollar demand.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela bolivar ends firm on weak dollar demand.

text.p: The Venezuelan bolivar firmed for the second day running to end at 476.50/477.50 per dollar, traders said, with private sector dollar sales largely prompting the bolivar's strength.
The unit closed Wednesday at 477.00/478.00 per dollar.
Central Bank intervention was only "very light, it was the sale by private clients of dollars combined with weak dollar demand that largely firmed the exchange rate," said one trader.
